column3: A context request with a request line not settled is not accepted

column4: When the person locates an identifier that a Python file defines, the code analysis service shall return every reference to the identifier and the number of references to the identifier and complete the request.

column3: An identifier located as one JSON object
column4: the CLI adapter's: the response envelope under --json (the decision "The response envelope", U16)

column3: An identifier no Python file defines is not located
column4: If the person locates an identifier that no Python file defines, then the code analysis service shall refuse the request and name the identifier.

column3: A file linted gives each finding under its analysis tool and fails
column4: While a file holds a finding of an analysis tool, when the person lints the file, the code analysis service shall return the heading of the analysis tool and the finding, fail the check and name the finding.

column3: Linting fails while `vulture` is missing
column4: While `vulture` is `missing`, when the person lints a file, the code analysis service shall fail the check and name `vulture`.

column3: A function is not traced while `coverage` is missing
column4: While `coverage` is `missing`, if the person traces a function, then the code analysis service shall refuse the request and name `coverage`.

column3: An identifier is not located while `jedi` is missing
column4: While `jedi` is `missing`, if the person locates an identifier, then the code analysis service shall refuse the request and name `jedi`.

column3: A Python file over the size limit fails the sizing
column4: While a Python file exceeds a size limit, when the person sizes this repository with the size limit, the code analysis service shall return the Python file, fail the check and name the Python file.

column3: Sizing passes when no Python file exceeds the default limit
column4: While no Python file exceeds the `300` size limit, when the person sizes this repository without a size limit, the code analysis service shall complete the request.

column3: An install in a virtualenv installs a missing `gf-rgl`
column4: While `gf-rgl` is `missing` and the environment of the Python interpreter is `virtualenv`, when the person installs the toolchain, the toolchain service shall install `gf-rgl`.

column3: A probe gives `gf-rgl`
column4: When the person probes the toolchain, the toolchain service shall return `gf-rgl`.

column3: Relocating a bounded context moves every old-layout directory
column4: While this repository holds an old-layout directory, when the person relocates a bounded context, the upgrades service shall change every old-layout directory and every file that mentions an old-layout directory.

column3: Relocating a bounded context turns its decision ledger into design-decisions
column4: While a decision ledger of this repository has a ledger entry, when the person relocates a bounded context, the upgrades service shall keep a design-decision of the ledger entry, keep no decision ledger, change the decisions index of this repository and complete the request.

column3: A superseded ledger entry becomes a superseded design-decision
column4: While a ledger entry supersedes another ledger entry, when the person relocates a bounded context, the upgrades service shall keep a design-decision of the ledger entry whose status is `superseded` and keep another design-decision that supersedes the design-decision.

column3: A superseding ledger entry's qualifier is kept
column4: While a ledger entry that has a qualifier supersedes another ledger entry, when the person relocates a bounded context, the upgrades service shall keep a design-decision that holds the qualifier.

column3: A ledger entry with no number is given one
column4: While a ledger entry of a decision ledger has no ledger number, when the person relocates a bounded context, the upgrades service shall keep a ledger number of the ledger entry.

column3: A Behaviour line with no id is given one
column4: While a Behaviour line of a capability has no line id, when the person relocates a bounded context, the upgrades service shall keep a line id of the Behaviour line.

column3: A bounded context whose ledger stem clashes with a tracked file is not relocated
column4: While a ledger entry has a stem and a tracked file in an old-layout directory has the same stem, if the person relocates a bounded context, then the upgrades service shall refuse the request and name the tracked file.

column3: No bounded context is relocated with an uncommitted change
column4: While this repository holds an uncommitted change, if the person relocates a bounded context, then the upgrades service shall refuse the request and name the uncommitted change.

column3: No repository is upgraded with an uncommitted change
column4: While this repository holds an uncommitted change, if the person upgrades this repository, then the upgrades service shall refuse the request and name the uncommitted change.

column3: A query before 0.24.0 gives the release and every upgrade step
column4: While the release of this repository is before `0.24.0`, when the person queries this repository, the upgrades service shall return the release of this repository and every upgrade step and complete the request.

column3: A query with no plugin version file gives every upgrade step
column4: While this repository has a shop directory and this repository has no plugin version file, when the person queries this repository, the upgrades service shall return every upgrade step.

column3: A query of a plugin version file with no version is refused
column4: While a plugin version file of this repository holds no version, if the person queries this repository, then the upgrades service shall refuse the request and name the content of the plugin version file.

column3: An upgrade before 0.24.0 renames the work-item files and stage directories
column4: While the release of this repository is before `0.24.0`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall return every upgrade step and change the plugin version file of this repository, every work-item file, every stage directory and every initiative log.

column3: An upgrade from 0.24 rewrites every work-item file
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.23.1` and before `0.25.0`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall change every work-item file.

column3: An upgrade to 0.30.0 restates a capability with no language
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.25.0` and before `0.30.0` and a capability of this repository has no language, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall keep a restated file, change the capability and return the restated file and the capability.

column3: An upgrade to 0.30.0 rewrites old references and deprecated scenarios
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.25.0` and before `0.30.0`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall change every work-item file that mentions a requirement and change every feature that holds a scenario that has the `@deprecated` tag.

column3: A session that starts before 0.24.0 is told the release and the upgrade steps
column4: While the release of this repository is before `0.24.0`, when a session starts, the upgrades service shall notify the session of the release of this repository, every upgrade step and `only on the person's yes`.

column3: A session that starts with no shop directory is told nothing
column4: While this repository has no shop directory, when a session starts, the upgrades service shall change nothing.

column3: A session that starts with a plugin version file of no version is told so
column4: While a plugin version file of this repository holds no version, when a session starts, the upgrades service shall notify the session of `holds no version` and the content of the plugin version file.

column3: An upgrade to 0.31.0 freezes the work queue
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.29.0` and before `0.31.0`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall keep a frozen notice and change the decisions index of this repository.

column3: An upgrade to 0.31.0 relocates each live frozen request of another asker
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.29.0` and before `0.31.0` and the asker of a frozen request is not `internal` and the frozen request is not `delivered`, `refused` or `withdrawn`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall change the frozen request.

column3: An upgrade to 0.31.0 names each open initiative
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.29.0` and before `0.31.0` and an initiative of this repository is not `done` or `abandoned`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall return every upgrade step whose release is `0.31.0` and the initiative.

column3: An upgrade to 0.31.0 names each live internal frozen request
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.29.0` and before `0.31.0` and the asker of a frozen request is `internal` and the frozen request is not `delivered`, `refused` or `withdrawn`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall return the frozen request.

column3: An upgrade to 0.32.0 names each term that violates v_t11
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.30.0` and before `0.32.0`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall change the index file of this bounded context and return every upgrade step whose release is `0.32.0` and every term that violates `v_t11`.

column3: An upgrade to 0.33.0 rewrites the index file and every capability
column4: While the release of this repository is after `0.32.0` and before `0.33.0`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall change the index file of this bounded context and every capability and return every upgrade step whose release is `0.33.0`.

column3: An upgrade to 0.34.0 names each term that violates w_value_kind
column4: While the release of this repository is `0.33.0`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall return every upgrade step whose release is `0.34.0` and every term that violates `w_value_kind`.

column3: An upgrade at the plugin's release changes nothing
column4: While the release of this repository is the same as the release of the plugin and the release of this repository is after `0.34.0`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall return `no upgrade step is pending` and change no file.

column3: A session that starts after the plugin's release is told to update the plugin
column4: While the release of this repository is after the release of the plugin, when a session starts, the upgrades service shall notify the session of `update the plugin`.

column3: A session that starts at the plugin's release with no open initiative is told nothing
column4: While the release of this repository is the same as the release of the plugin and the release of this repository is after `0.24.0` and every initiative of this repository is one of `done` or `abandoned`, when a session starts, the upgrades service shall not notify the session of an upgrade step and not notify the session of an initiative.

column3: An upgrade at a patch release keeps the new plugin version
column4: While the release of this repository is `0.34.0` and the release of the plugin is `0.34.1`, when the person upgrades this repository, the upgrades service shall return `no upgrade step is pending`, change the plugin version file of this repository and keep the plugin version file.
